messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up — for the Orion preview cohort we need a small 'onboarding telemetry' sprint so we can correlate early usage with renewal risk. thinking: opt-in prompt, 2 question post-setup micro-survey, and a lightweight event schema.
Jasper: sounds good. timeline? can we tag customers who skipped setup flows?
Nina: target next week to start sampling (10 accounts). goal: map "time-to-first-success" -> NPS and product usage.
Ally: I can own the micro-survey + email copy. will keep it 2 questions: one rating, one short pain point.
Ravi: I'll add telemetry flags in the onboarding flow. need the exact events we want. would love a minimal list.
Nina: minimal events: onboarding_started, sample_api_call_success, first_embed_created, guide_viewed. also opt_in_telemetry boolean.
Jasper: to reduce friction, show an inline opt-in during first console walkthrough. copy suggestion: "Help us improve onboarding — share anonymous product usage" with a link to privacy.
Ally: draft here: https://tiny.redwood/optin-draft — short, can split test copy.
Ravi: prod-bot FYI will emit a tag when flag turned on: team-prodhook -> "onboard-telemetry:v1"
prod-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC — will post rollout update in #eng-platform once live. :rocket:
Jasper: how will we alert AMs when a sampled account shows low engagement?
Nina: create a simple rule in Customer Health: if time-to-first-success > 7 days OR no sample_api_call in first 72h -> flag as "activation-risk" and ping AM.
Ally: I'll add a templated playbook for AMs with 3 quick actions: 1) scheduled coaching call 2) offer enablement session 3) share quick config checklist.
Ravi: rolling the event schema to staging now. attaching the minimal JSON snippet below for product to ingest:
```
{
  "event": "sample_api_call_success",
  "user_id": "<anon_id>",
  "opt_in": true,
  "time": "iso8601"
}
```
Nina: perfect. can we ensure events are anonymized and tied only to account-level id when opt_in=false? legal asked for that.
Ravi: confirmed — we'll hash user_id and only surface account_id to CS.
Jasper: awesome. next steps: Ally to finish survey copy by EOD Thurs, Ravi to stage events by Fri, Nina to create the Customer Health rule and add AM playbook draft.
Ally: noted. I'll also stub a 30s Loom for AMs on how to interpret the flag.
Nina: thanks team. small experiment, high signal. will loop back with initial cohort readout after two weeks. :sparkles:
